title: BPW-2026-0479
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0479
CD ALL
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – SOLID RESOURCES FLEET TELEMATICS AND SERVICE CONFIRMATION PLATFORM
Recommending the Board:
DEEM Samsara, Inc., Routeware, Inc., and Verizon Connect Fleet USA LLC responsive to the Business Inclusion Program requirements for the pre-qualified list of vendors for solid resources fleet telematics and service confirmation platform;
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation (BOS), or her designee, to establish a list of three pre-qualified telematics vendors consisting of the aforementioned vendors; and
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of BOS, or her designee, to negotiate a contract with the highest-ranked vendor and, if negotiations are unsuccessful with that vendor, proceed in rank order with the remaining pre-qualified vendors.
(W.O.: S02MFTPP)
summary: Pre-qualification of vendors and authorization for negotiations for solid resources fleet telematics and service confirmation platform.
